statuspage_desc: Statuspage is an Atlassian product that some companies use for communicating service health, incident updates and maintenances. Some of them (like GitHub, Jira or Discord) use it with open API that app can read and display.
servers_desc:
You can track any server's availability from your device, by adding it. The app will ping it continuously and report if it is online or not.

If you want to have more info, you can use AIO.php script that allows the app to read server's telemetry, like CPU, RAM, network usage and uptime.

intro_welcome_desc:
Your server and service monitoring toolkit.

PTK lets you keep an eye on servers, track their performance with open-source script, and monitor the status of cloud services — all from your phone.

(PTK stands for Puzzak's ToolKit)
intro_ping_desc:
PTK monitors servers using TCP pings — lightweight network probes that measure latency and availability.

No installation needed on the server. Just add the URL and PTK will start tracking response times and online status in real time.
intro_aio_desc:
Install the AIO.php script on the server to unlock full telemetry:
CPU load & temperature, RAM usage, Network throughput and System uptime.

All metrics are displayed in real-time charts with history.
intro_statuspage_desc:
Monitor your favorite cloud services that use Atlassian Statuspage.

Get instant visibility into incidents, scheduled maintenance, and component health for services like GitHub, Cloudflare, Discord, and much more.
